_note: The possibilities gallery on the four kind hubs (D259). Each card is one job, its apps (catalog slugs) and the ask Captain gets. from "app" is a starting ask in agentic-apps/app/src/features/templates/list.ts (template = its key; team ops there is operations here, and the Shopify orders template is filed under ecommerce); from "site" was written for the site, within scripts/pages/product-facts.md and the catalog's real triggers and actions. Checked by scripts/pages/gates-hubs.mjs.
